description: Constructed AR(1) daily if-held return series with the SAME positive lag-1 persistence structure as persistence_stats_ar1_positive.json but a negative drift, giving sharpe_daily <= 0. Golden fixture pinning the NEGATIVE_EDGE verdict class and, specifically, that it takes priority over SUFFICIENT_MET/LIKELY even though rho >= sharpe_daily is trivially true whenever sharpe_daily <= 0 (AC-3's explicit trap).
provenance: Deterministic construction, not captured from any producer. Identical generation to persistence_stats_ar1_positive.json (phi=0.55, seed=7, same AR(1) shock sequence) except daily_returns_pct[t] = (0.06 * r[t] - 0.03) * 100 -- a negative drift instead of +0.035. rho is therefore numerically IDENTICAL to the positive-drift fixture (autocorrelation is invariant to an additive shift); only the mean (and hence sharpe_daily) changes sign. Expected rho/sharpe are computed by the test from this raw series via an independent reference formula, never hardcoded here.
